17:
I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps.  They grow in clusters, deep in the Uldaman dig site; they may be elsewhere, but for now that's the only place I know they're at.  I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.

Find the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps.  Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.

Do this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of my famous greater mender's potion for you!
Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.
67:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
117:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew 5 hops to complete his special brew.
167:
We were deep in a vast mine in Westfall, hidden beneath a barn in Moonbrook. No clue where these stinkin' thieving types came from. Anyway, the mine tunnel collapsed on us. I got out but the others... well... the others haven't been heard from.

You look like you might have better luck in there. If you could look for my brother, I'd be thankful.  He always carried his Explorers' League Badge. If you can't find him, that badge would at least give me some peace of mind.
Bring Foreman Thistlenettle's Explorers' League Badge to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
217:
{name}, our scouts have identified the leader of this recent Trogg incursion.  It appears that these beasts in Loch Modan are following the lead of a chieftain named Grawmug.  Grawmug is heavily guarded, however.  Two of his most elite guards, Gnasher and Brawler, never leave his side.

If you feel yourself worthy, {name}, I want you to lead the assassination mission on Grawmug and his two thugs.  With the Trogg leadership dead, we just might stand a chance at pushing these beasts back into the ground.
Kill the Trogg leader, Grawmug, and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler then report back to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
267:
{class}, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
Bring 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.
317:
I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?

I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
Gather 4 Chunks of Boar Meat and 2 Thick Bear Furs, and deliver them to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
367:
Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood.
417:
Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.

Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.

However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

Revenge against Mangeclaw.
Kill Mangeclaw.$B$BBring his Mangy Claw and Hildelve's Journal to Pilot Hammerfoot.
467:
Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should!  And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him.  If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
517:
This new elixir is finally ready to be tested.  But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog?  Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.

Head down to Dun Garok.  You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about.  Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout.  Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, {name}.
Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
567:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
High Executor Darthalia of Tarren Mill is offering a bounty on Clerk Horrace Whitesteed, Citizen Wilkes, Miner Hackett and Farmer Kalaba.
617:
You looking fer work, {name}? I might have some if you're up for a little challenge.

I got a friend named Groy who makes a killing selling what the naga call akiris reed: it's some kind of valuable ocean reed. Not too sure what it's for, but he pays well for bundles of the stuff.

Ya bring me ten stalks of the stuff, and we'll have business to do. The naga were last seen along the beach to the north of here.
Bring 10 Bundles of Akiris Reed to Privateer Bloads in Booty Bay.
667:
This is bad. It seems the Daggerspines are amassing for an attack.

Naga are known for their ruthlessness in battle. They will keep attacking until I am dead.

I don't value my own life above that of my crew members, but you must help to defend me. The crew will not be able to make it back to Booty Bay without my knowledge of the seas.

The naga will be coming from the sea. I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack. Man the cannon and drive them back.

Are you ready, {name}?
Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.
717:
It has become obvious that we cannot ensure that Blacklash and Hematus will remain imprisoned in Lethlor. That black dragons have taken up residence there, and that the ogres managed to steal the Sign indicates that more drastic measures will have to be taken.

The drakes' prison is maintained by three runestones that may only be retrieved using the Sign of the Earth. Those runestones can then be used to break the seal which imprisons them.

{name}... assure that their dreams are eternal.

Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal, and Diamond and obtain the Runestones.$B$BPlace the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.$B$BSlay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Garek.
767:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
817:
Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, {name}. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
867:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
Collect 8 Witchwing talons.$B$BReturn them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
917:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young {class}.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
Bring a Webwood Egg to Gilshalan in Aldrassil.
967:
My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.

Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.

You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
Deliver Balthule's letter to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale Forest.
1017:
There's only one undead mage in the Barrens capable of defiling this many water elementals. He's also the only one foolish enough to try. Sarilus Foulborne is probably sitting at the top of Dreadmist Peak, laughing at me.

{name}, you must go into enemy territory and destroy this miscreant. I have had enough of his idiocy and we must show him what happens to those who annoy the Sentinels.

Destroy him and bring me his head. Be wary though, the Horde may be watching for you.
Slay Sarilus Foulborne and bring his head to Sentinel Velene Starstrike in Silverwind Refuge.
1067:
Here is the toxin.  If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results.  I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!

But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah.  She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.
1117:
I had to use some of my favors, and gave away a rare bottle of elven wine, and did some heavy deducing myself!  But I found the information you seek.

Here, I wrote a letter with some very interesting bits on our friend, Nazz Steamboil.  Do with it what you will -- it's too dangerous for me to use.

Just don't tell anyone where you got it!
Bring the Goblin Rumors to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
1167: Before confronting Athrikus, it would probably be wise for you to consult with Balthule. I have no doubt he has been vigilant in his watch of the Tower, and he may have information about recent developments.
Speak with Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx.
1267: Hello, {name}. Tervosh has explained to me much of your quest. When it was brought to my attention that you were seeking one of the men directly responsible for the missing diplomat, well, we were forced to find you to ensure he was dealt with quickly.
Speak to Jaina Proudmore in Dustwallow Swamp.
1367:
To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them.  We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

If you choose to ally with the Magram then slay their foes, the Gelkis.  This will earn you respect among the Magram.  When you earn enough, then meet with the Magram spokesman Warug, on the outskirts of the Magram Village, in southeast Desolace.
Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.
1467:
To get paid, you're gonna have to get back to Ironforge and speak to Roetten himself. He'll love getting Leftwitch's package out of the way anyway. Just give him this and it should be enough to get your booty.

And don't worry, I'm still going to put in a good word for you when I get back. I shouldn't be in Desolace much longer.
Bring Leftwitch's Package back to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.
2767:
The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:

"I need to move OOX-22/FE to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure.  It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again.  Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the dock along the Forgotten Coast!  That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"

"Escort it safely to the dock, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay!  Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
2867: With the discovery of the strange gazebo in the heart of the Ruins of Solarsal, the time has come to return to Feathermoon Stronghold and report to General Shandris Feathermoon what has been discovered here.
Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.
2967:
You access the pedestal again; the platinum discs suddenly appear once more in your backpack.

With the knowledge of the stone watcher learned and the discs returned to your possession, the time has come to return to Thunder Bluff and inform the Nara Wildmane of your discovery.
Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
3367:
<Dorius groans.>

I'm badly injured, {race}. Feel... light headed... World spinning... Bleeding... internally.

I must get back to Ironforge. Help me, {name}.
Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.$B
3517:
I admit, {name}, I've made the most of my situation in Azshara. Belgrom's punishment has had its share of benefits.

Before I left, I did some research and you would be surprised how many valuable items are lying around.

There are tablets throughout the Ruins of Eldarath to the east that I need. All four are named after highborne wizards. Get them for me and we'll talk some more.
Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.
4117: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a whipper root plant.  The visible roots of the plant appear tough and leathery, and a slimy film hangs from the plant.  It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
4267:
I am entrusting you with a copy of the report Raschal made on the infestation of southeastern Feralas.  While the main report is being filed in Darnassus, I want you to give this copy to an associate of the Protectorate.  Her name is Gracina Spiritmight; she is a priestess who dwells in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  She has broad knowledge on these kinds of creatures, and her receiving this report would benefit us all.

You're dismissed - good luck, {name}; may Elune watch over us all.
Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
4467: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant.  The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous.  It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
4767:
I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, {name}.

I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.
4867:
Argh!  So hard to speak!

Take this note!  Get me my mojo!
Read Warosh's Scroll.  Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
5067:
While the crafting of such an item has never successfully been accomplished, it is thought to be possible - under the right circumstance.

Should the seeker of arcanum desire to imbue leggings with immense power, the following they must find:

* The pristine hide of the Beast.

* Frayed abomination stitchings.

*Arcanite Bars.

*Frostwhisper's embalming fluid.

BEHOLD!

In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid.$B$BYou will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item.
5167: The carapace of a mature chromatic drake is needed to form the foundation of the leggings. Brilliant chromatic scales are then layered upon the wire frame and enchanted in the blood of heroes. Finally, the supple skin of shadow must be applied to the inner greaves.

To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':$B$B1 Chromatic Carapace.$B$B10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.$B$B10 Blood of Heroes.$B$B5 Skin of Shadow.
5217:
You fill the bottle with enough of the cauldron's poisonous concoction for a suitable sample to be studied.

With the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
5517:
Brother {name} - your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily.  As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously.  Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes!

Bring to me twenty-five valor tokens as a sign of tribute, and I'll give you the finest of all our mantles.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
6567:
I have received word from one of my champions that a way into the lair of the dragon may exist. You are to seek him out.

Rexxar wanders the desert wasteland of Desolace, traveling between Stonetalon and Feralas. He awaits your arrival.
Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.
7067:
Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.

The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.

If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
7167:
Drek'Thar sings your praises. Kalimdor is abuzz with tales of your heroics. The Warchief glows - your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.

You have earned the Eye of Command.

Present your insignia, Commander {name}.

<Warmaster Laggrond salutes.>
7367:
The Frostwolf have their front lines and bases booby trapped, {class}. You have to watch your step when invading enemy territory.

If you want to make a solid strike against them, you must destroy their source of anti personnel munitions - I'm talking about their explosives expert. If you kill him, you are safe to disarm the mines. As long as he is kept down, the mines will also stay down.

You will probably find him in a tower near the Iceblood Garrison. Good luck!
Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
7817:
Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Undercity, I assure you!

If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
8067:
We Zandalar prize what we wear as a symbol of accomplishment.  You don't need to be able to see what one wears to be able to sense what emanates from it - power transcends sight.  The garments of the Zandalar predator are like this, and most cherished by them is the mantle they wear.  It helps to obfuscate them from view... and to make their presence known when they wish it.

The Paragons of Power await your retrieval in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me what I seek, and the predator's mantle shall be yours.

Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Aegis.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.$B$BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
8117:
Sha-mon! Maywiki make a joke!

<Maywiki laughs.>

So, you been using the spirits and elements against our enemies in Zul'Gurub, eh? Spirits be praised!

Maywiki gonna brighten your orb. Give it here, {name}.
8167:
{name}, the battle for Arathi Basin is a battle for resources and territory.  Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies.  I charge you to assault the points farthest from our Arathi Basin base.

Assault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy.  Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post!

When you have done this to all four points, return to me.
Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
8267: If you happen to have another Ribbons of Sacrifice for participating in the battle at Warsong Gulch, I will accept them on behalf of the Silvering Sentinels.
Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Captain Shatterskull so that the Outriders may reward you for acting on our behalf.
8367:
Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor!  The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters.  We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.

Go forth and crush the Alliance in Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch!  For Honor!  For the Horde!
Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8467:
While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe.  To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you.

Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.  Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
8667:
The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity.  They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.

In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns.  But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.

Bring me the components I require, {name}.  I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
8917:
Hail, {class}!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.

Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.

I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
8967:
It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.

She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.

Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
9017:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Beaststalker's Boots, Beaststalker's Pants and Beaststalker's Mantle.
9117:
<Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.>

Blessed boy, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity.

Bring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.

Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Belt of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Belt, 8 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Arcane Crystals and 2 Mooncloth.
9267:
You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, {name}!  Word's been getting around of your dirty deeds.

You're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers.  This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel.  Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions.
66317: You open the aged and weathered tome and discover text detailing a necromantic ritual. Perhaps Archmage Tarsis would be interested in having this information.
78267:
I'll need some of the Venture Company's Shredder Turbochargers. They're tightly coupled to the shredder systems, so you'll need special equipment to salvage them.

No, I don't have that equipment.
78917: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead.  Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
81817: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'wath. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Sanathel there and return to me.
81867: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough and collect Moondragon Scales from the dragonkin within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a skinner.
81917:
I have seen this creature you call "Calefactus" many times in my field studies. By all accounts, it appears to be a nigh-invulnerable core hound made from Fel energies.

However, if what you say is true, and the Twilight's Hammer were planning to enslave it, then there may be a way to subdue the beast.

The Shadowsworn, to the south-east, are known to perform dark rituals, including the enslavement of Fel creatures. Perhaps members of their order carry a clue to weakening Calefactus?
82017: The dread aura you experienced emanates not from a place, but from a creature. A particularly deadly creature of darkness, a twisted shadow reflection of the worst aspects of our world, coalesced into an amalgamation of pure nightmare. I can't explain how I know this but I... dreamt of it. Or rather, it was shown to me. It's difficult to explain.  Please, go to Moonglade and speak with the druid Loganaar. There may still be time to stop it before it gets even more powerful.
84167: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
85617:
The King has acknowledged your existence, {class}. You are the first of your kind to be accepted by Rastakhan as a true ally of Zandalar.

You will be rewarded greatly for your efforts. Present your brand and I shall apply the final amplification.
86667:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86967:
<The man's one open eye locks with yours.>

Psst, hey you. Yes, you! Think you can get me out of here? I've been lying here playing dead for hours but its only a matter of time before these damned ogres remember I'm here and come to eat me, or worse! 

This cage is locked up pretty tight but one of these brutes should have the key. See if you can find one and let me out. I'd certainly be in your debt. 

I'm going to keep playing dead while you get to work. Now go... quietly!
87517:
It seems that the beast that attacked light's hope is Caldoran's pet and the attack on Light's Hope was merely a ruse to draw our forces out and commit us to this attack. Caldoran and Beatrix sought to use us to create a distraction and remove a rival in Balnazzar, and then turn on us and remove us as a presence in the Plaguelands after they regained control. 

We don't have all of the answers and it's looking grim, but we will put these dogs down for this treachery.
88717:
Bring me any doomed souls that cross your path, {name}.

Let me rephrase that - you MUST bring them to me.
MY duty is to stay and guide the souls of the lost. YOUR duty is to bring them to me.

A word of advice, never handle more than one soul at a time. Trust me, your soul can only handle so much, and your mind... well... it can handle even less.

This burden is now yours. Because you can, you must. 

Consider this a moral obligation.
88917:
I came here in search of highborne artifacts. You could call me an archaeologist of sorts.

The ruins of Eldarath to the west hold many of them, although the naga are looting the ruins as we speak.

A naga called Lady Sesspira leads the pillaging; no doubt keeping the best finds for herself. 

If my research is correct, I believe she may be in possession of the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage.

I need your help to get that staff, {race}. Scholars like me are ill-suited for combat.
89567:
Lord Tyrosus has asked me to investigate the remnants of a Scarlet Crusade caravan in Plaguewood along the road to Stratholme. 

Recent reports tell of extensive crusade movements all across the plaguelands leading up to the schism at Tyr's Hand, and this caravan may be able to provide us with some indication as to their purpose. 

I'll meet you there and we will investigate this together.
90567:
<You have found a vial of foul, viscous liquid on a laboratory table. It was surrounded by various ingredients that have been meticulously measured and diced into careful portions. Though the herbs are unidentifiable, one undamaged and discolored beast heart rested nearby.

Alchemists in Darnassus might have an idea of how to tap into whatever restorative properties might be present in the potion. You should also bring them some flowers, as to not come barreling into a shop with just a pile of hearts.>
92017:
The flying creatures of the Summit still draw breath from the highest currents, where the corruption has not yet fully taken hold. Hippogryph feathers and chimaera hair drift through these winds, absorbing what the air remembers of an unspoiled land. I need these remnants to anchor and strengthen my purifying incense.

Gather them for me, so I may concentrate the wind's knowledge into cleansing smoke before we begin the ritual.
92067:
You have certainly proven yourself to me, {name}, but the others of my tribe are less easily persuaded. For that, you will need to continue your efforts against the Legashi.

Bring to me the horns of slain Legashi satyr. Every bundle you bring me will serve as a symbol of your service to the Blackmaw.
92317:
So, the hermit druid seeks a force to balance the 'life' in this magic of his? Then the answer is death, naturally. You have come to the right place for such a thing.

No doubt you've seen the undead crawling all over my domain. They are fueled by stolen power that animates them even in death.

That stolen power is exactly what is needed in this spell you speak of. Kill the undead and search through their skulls for a coalesced Drop of Stolen Life. Return it to Ketharas once you have it.
92467:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.
92517:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92817:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
92867:
Our heritage may be crumbling, but this is not our final redoubt. We have more in reserve, and it must remain hidden for its own protection.

Support grows for preserving our remaining sculptures and sacred burial grounds. The rabble that have taken up residence in our old kingdom have no notion of the vengeance coming for them.

Drive back the Boulderfist and Syndicate. They must learn Stromgarde is not merely fist, eagle, and stones.
93167: I've had a bit of a think since you brought me back this old gadget. I may have had a change of heart about getting my memories back...
93317:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93567:
This mountain cliff to the southeast... the remains of the tower. Seared into my mind, their harrowing screams still echo forever in memories.

Allow me to unburden myself and tell you of my defeat.
93617:
The hierarchy of the Wild Gods is bent. Now, all is in motion, and the nature of the world is as malleable as clay!

No more will my kin suffer the fangs of predators, for now, we shall prey upon all who have devoured us!

Tremble, fragile creature, for you have neither the strength nor the speed to dissuade us!
94217: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94267: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Wildvine Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94317: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Dreamless Sleep Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94617:
There's a pack of coyotes livin' in a den west of here. We can see 'em sometimes from across the river. They used to hunt fish on the shore, but I guess the murlocs pushed 'em out of their usual feeding ground, and so they've taken to eating horses.

The leader of the coyote pack's a bigger one with dark fur. We'd nicknamed him "Sootfur". I reckon if you kill him, the rest'll scatter.
95217:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95267:
The last part's <hic> easy...just take that big ball 'a guts, aaand chuck it in the water! Er...not here though...that'd be a disaster.

Go to those <hic> murloc islands, where ya found the drawing. Look for fresh wreckage in the water. That's where you gotta throw the bait.

Soon as that thing sticks its head up, chop it off! We'll make a decoration of it...for the boat!
95317:
Listen, {class}. There have been some awfully noisy visitors just up the mountain. They are tainting the land with their foul demon magic and experimenting with piles of ash. It's high time we investigate.

By we, I mean you.

I want you to poke around and investigate their camp! See if you can bring me some notes on what our mysterious fel 'friends' have been up to. Surely with egos that large they've written something we can utilize. Perhaps they are carrying something on their person?
95417:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.
95817:
Have you ever met Rotgath Stonebeard? He is a dwarven blacksmith in Ironforge. Not the most chatty fellow around, but always reliable. We often come to him when we need bulk crafts of simpler designs--the kind that Stondry is too proud to take on himself.

His turnaround times are excellent, particularly when it comes to helping new craftspeople get their shops established. I would trust no other to get your sign made fast. Let him know I sent you if he gives you any trouble!
96067:
You may have noticed my mechanical companion here, G45-B4G. Whirlin' around in that burlap chest of his is the one, and only, working prototype of my gas-powered engine.

I figure it's in need of some stress testing. How'd you like to take him on in a fight? I can power him up with the gas you've collected.

Oh, and don't worry about hurting him. He can't feel a thing!
96367:
The master craftsman returns. Your presence is welcome.

By now, I assume you need no reminder of the details of our agreement, but I will offer a refresher nonetheless. From the options that remain, you can choose one more type of armor to focus your skills on. Additionally, I will offer another recipe from my selection to you for free.

Of the final type of equipment that we pass over today, you will be able to learn after more victories.
96917: You're in luck, pal. I'm sending you on an unpaid vacation to the sunny Darkspear Isles. Get in there and do your thing. Just uh, try not to die, okay?
97017:
Ah, it's a big day fer ya I see; here for yer first ram are ye?

These rams are the most steadfast and sturdy in all of Azeroth. They're fiercely protective of their rider. Aye, you'll have a hard time finding a more stalwart companion for yer journeys.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry lad, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.
97267:
<You discovered an intriguing owl figurine while exploring the Barrow Deeps. It is carved out of an unusual and durable stone, with two sapphires socketed into its eyes. A small hum of magic accompanies a subtle, dying glow from the two gemstones.

The Watchers standing vigil outside of the tunnels would likely be interested in this discovery.>
97617:
Hullo there, you look like the helpful sort.

The name's Dorgaron, and I'm with the Explorers' League. We've not had the best of luck with diggin' in the Badlands, but I know darn well there's artifacts to find and collect!

Before I can convince the boss to let us send another crew out here, I need to prove that the dig sites are safe AND haven't been picked clean.

If you find yourself down south, gather a few reasonably intact artifacts and some leftover equipment that hasn't been smashed yet.
98067:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98417:
At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.

Kurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.

Our bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.
98917:
You've handed the horde a decisive defeat at the Darkspear Islands, and now it's time to break their spirits once and for all. Dominate the battlefield utterly, and defeat the enemy while controlling all four outposts. 

Do this and show the Horde the unrelenting supremacy of The Theramore Expeditionary Force.
99017:
In the ruins of Dire Maul lies the seat of the king of the Gordok ogres. This warlord has plundered most of the riches of the fallen kingdom of the kaldorei, including the crown jewels of the ruling house of ancient Eldre'Thalas. I require these gems and you will retrieve them for me.

These riches will be well hidden, so you may need to use guile to not only defeat the king, but earn the tribute of his followers. Return the jewels to me and I will purify the corrupted leg armor you carry.
99217:
Ah, I've been expecting you {name}. It would seem the winds have brought you to me once again, so you may ride our fastest and strongest kodos.

Today, I am proud to present to you your next kodo. Much like yourself, each has grown stronger and faster since you last met.

You and your kodo will travel the world together just like before, so find which one speaks to you.

Go examine the armored kodos and return to me when you have made your choice.
99367:
Greetings, {name}! I am so glad to see you've returned to us.

It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys.

Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here.

Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
